description:
Discover the epitome of luxury living at Occu Hayfield, an exclusive collection of elegant 1, 2 and 3- bedroom apartments in the heart of Killiney. 

Nestled in the affluent suburb of Killiney, Hayfield offers a unique blend of coastal charm and urban convenience. 

Perfectly positioned with stunning views of Dublin Bay and the Wicklow Mountains. With beautiful beaches and historic Killiney Hill Park on your doorstep, Killiney provides an idyllic setting for your new home. 

Each apartment is thoughtfully designed to offer modern comfort and style, creating a perfect sanctuary for you to call home.
 
Standard features of Hayfield apartments include:
- Beautifully designed interiors with sleek and bespoke furnishings
- Large private balconies and beautifully maintained courtyards
- Access to our dedicated Reside

At Occu, we believe that renting should be better. That's why we're working hard to bring you the best: smarter, benefit focused and centred around the needs of our residents. No uncertainty, no hidden costs, stunning homes (and we'll let your pets move in too!). Better Renting. That's different. 

Please note: BER's range from A2-A3
